attempts.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured its login sessions to a limit of 8,192 open files (nofile) and 256 processes (nproc) via /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf, verified enforcement in a real login shell (su -l), then performed the mandatory restart protocol on node1: captured baseline boot_id, issued a safe reboot with returned acknowledgement, polled until reconnection, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified the account and limits were intact post-restart.
